related_work.title: The Materials Project: A materials genome approach to accelerating materials innovation
key_contributions: High-throughput DFT computation framework for 33,000+ compounds
Open data access via web apps and REST API (pymatgen)
FireWorks workflow management for automated calculations
related_work.relevance: Establishes the data infrastructure and vision for AI-driven materials discovery

related_work.title: Physics-informed machine learning
key_contributions: Three pathways for physics embedding: observational, inductive, learning biases
Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for PDE-constrained learning
Integration of noisy data with mathematical models
Applications to forward and inverse problems
related_work.relevance: Provides framework for incorporating physical constraints (DFT, elasticity) into ML models

related_work.title: Crystal Graph Convolutional Neural Networks (CGCNN)
key_contributions: Crystal graph representation encoding atom connectivity and bonding
MAE 0.039 eV/atom for formation energy (DFT accuracy)
Atom-level energy decomposition for design rule discovery
related_work.relevance: State-of-the-art architecture for property prediction from crystal structures

related_work.title: Machine-learning-assisted materials discovery using failed experiments
key_contributions: SVM model trained on successful AND failed reactions (dark reactions)
Decision tree interpretation yielding chemical hypotheses
Feedback loop: model predictions guide subsequent experiments
related_work.relevance: Demonstrates value of negative data and interpretable ML for synthesis optimization

integration_summary: All four papers inform the integrated framework: Materials Project (data infrastructure), PINNs (physics constraints), CGCNN (graph-based featurization), and dark reactions (optimization from historical data).
